sourceBreakdowns.basis: Exact Michigan SIGMA checkbook rows filtered to FY2024, Health and Human Services, Contractual Services, Supplies, and Materials, and External Purchased Services. The 12 accounting-period exports contain 373,872 payment rows and reconcile in integer cents to the parent total. Michigan excludes payments that are private, confidential, or protected under state or federal law.
